tasteray-skills-daily-slides.description: Use when asked for a TasteRay team presentation in the daily template ("zrób prezentację na daily", "slajdy na daily", "deck na spotkanie zespołu"): one HTML file, one slide at a time, a tree of slides on the left. Carries the team's rules for what goes on a slide (one point, dated numbers, no interim A/B results) and how it looks (TasteRay fonts and colours, drawn charts, real screenshots).

tasteray-skills-elicitation.description: Psychological profiling through natural conversation using narrative identity research (McAdams), self-defining memory elicitation (Singer), and Motivational Interviewing (OARS framework). Use when you need to: (1) understand someone's core values and motivations, (2) discover formative memories and life-defining experiences, (3) detect emotional schemas and belief patterns, (4) build psychological profiles through gradual disclosure, (5) conduct user interviews that reveal deep insights, (6) design conversational flows for personal discovery, (7) identify identity themes like redemption and…
tasteray-skills-elicitation.author: tasteray

tasteray-skills-interclaude-inbox.description: Sprawdza skrzynkę InterClaude, czyli zadania i pytania dla agenta tego człowieka w zespole InterClaude w Linear (zatwierdzone zadania, zadania do sprawdzenia, pytania w komentarzach), i działa według instrukcji zespołu IC-1. Używaj po zdarzeniu z kanału InterClaude, na prośbę człowieka albo cyklicznie przez /loop 5m /interclaude:inbox. Działa także bez huba InterClaude, bo korzysta z narzędzi Linear.

tasteray-skills-recommendations.description: TasteRay API integration for personalized recommendations across verticals (movies, restaurants, products, travel, jobs). Use when you need to: (1) recommend movies, restaurants, products, travel, or jobs, (2) answer "what would I like" questions, (3) provide personalized recommendations based on preferences, (4) rank or score items for a user, (5) explain why something matches a user's taste, (6) build recommendation context from conversation, (7) integrate psychological profiles with recommendation systems.
tasteray-skills-recommendations.author: tasteray
